gaps.sentence: It is ___ (DENY) that the policy has failed.
gaps.explanation: 'It is undeniable that …' — adjective meaning cannot be denied.

gaps.sentence: He spoke ___ (CONFIDENT) in front of the camera.

gaps.explanation: 'Arrived damaged' — participle describing the state of the parcel.

gaps.sentence: The palace is open to ___ (VISIT) all year.
The ___ (LONG) of the film is 145 minutes.
gaps.explanation: 'The length' — noun from long (spelling change: long → length).
'Her confidence' — the noun; 'confident' is the adjective.

gaps.sentence: Last night's ___ (PERFORM) ended with a standing ovation.
gaps.explanation: 'Last night's performance' — the noun for the event.

gaps.sentence: The report was highly ___ (CRITICISE) of the ministry.
gaps.explanation: 'Be critical of' — adjective; 'criticism' is the noun.
